metadata.certifiedDate: Certified for Tax Year 2026 by Morris County Board of Taxation (District 1429)
metadata.sourceAgency: Morris County Board of Taxation & Parsippany-Troy Hills Tax Collector

location: Township of Parsippany-Troy Hills, Morris County, New Jersey

breakdown.description: Funds 14 public schools (10 elementary, 2 middle: Brooklawn & Central, 2 high schools: Parsippany HS & Parsippany Hills HS) educating ~7,120 students.

components.name: Regular Instruction & Classrooms
components.description: Teacher salaries across 14 schools, STEM/AP programs, textbooks, and instructional tech

components.name: Employee Health & Pension Benefits
components.description: SEHBP/NJEHP medical & prescription coverage, dental, FICA, and statutory benefit surges

components.name: Special Education & Out-of-District Tuition
components.description: Mandated IEP instruction, therapies, and Morris County Vo-Tech / private placements

components.name: Operations, Facilities & Plant Maintenance
components.description: Upkeep across 14 school campuses, custodial staff, utilities, and security

components.name: Student Transportation & Busing
components.description: District fleet and contracted routes across 25.4 sq miles

components.name: School & District Administration
components.description: Superintendent, Business Administrator, 14 school principals, legal & audit

components.name: Student Support, Guidance & Athletics
components.description: Guidance counselors, nurses, Red Hawks & Vikings athletics, and co-curriculars

breakdown.entity: Township of Parsippany-Troy Hills (Municipal + Fire Districts 1–6)
breakdown.description: Funds Township Police, DPW, Parks & Forestry, Sanitation, Library, Open Space, and Parsippany's 6 independent Fire Districts.

components.name: Parsippany Police Department & Public Safety
components.description: Patrol, detectives, traffic enforcement, 911 communications, and emergency management

components.name: Statutory Pensions (PFRS & PERS) & Health Insurance
components.description: Police & civilian pensions, active/retiree health benefits, and risk insurance

components.name: Public Works, Roads, Parks & Sanitation
components.description: Road resurfacing, snow removal across 25+ sq miles, sanitation/recycling, and parks

components.name: Municipal Debt Service & Capital Notes
components.description: Bond principal and interest for township infrastructure and equipment

components.name: 6 Independent Fire Districts (Districts 1–6)
components.description: Mount Tabor (#1), Rainbow Lakes (#2), Lake Parsippany (#3), Lake Hiawatha (#4), Rockaway Neck (#5), Parsippany-Troy Hills (#6)

components.name: General Governance, Legal, Finance & Assessor
components.description: Mayor & Council, Business Administrator, Clerk, CFO, Tax Assessor, and Township Attorney

components.name: Library System (Main, Lake Hiawatha, Mt. Tabor) & Human Services
components.description: 3 branch libraries, Health Department, Senior Community Center, and Recreation

breakdown.description: Parsippany's apportionment of the Morris County budget, funding County College of Morris (CCM), Morris County Park Commission, County Roads, Sheriff, and Human Services.

subcategories.name: Morris County Open Space & Farmland Preservation

components.name: Morris County Public Safety, Sheriff & Corrections
components.description: Morris County Sheriff's Office, Correctional Facility, Prosecutor, and OEM

components.name: County Roads, Bridges & Engineering
components.description: Maintenance of county arteries (Littleton Rd, Parsippany Blvd, Vail Rd, Intervale Rd)

components.name: Health, Human Services & Aging
components.description: Morris County Office of Temporary Assistance, aging services, and mental health

components.name: Higher Education (CCM & Morris Vo-Tech)
components.description: County College of Morris (Randolph) and Morris County Vocational School District (Denville)

components.name: Morris County Park Commission & Open Space
components.description: Central Park of Morris County, Tourne County Park, Jonathan's Woods, and trail network

components.name: Judiciary, County Clerk & Administration
components.description: Morristown Courthouse operations, Surrogate, County Clerk, and Board of Commissioners
